title: engravings
lyrics:
[00:14.28]Eyes, blood, bones
[00:16.70]Stuck in your rainbow clothes
[00:21.10]Rest my case
[00:23.76]If it's not rearranged
[00:28.43]Trading panic attacks
[00:30.06]You finally threw it all back
[00:31.72]Then told me how he abused you
[00:35.25]You had to gut out the truth
[00:37.15]But I already knew that you've got nothing left to lose
[00:41.78]Strip for me
[00:43.97]Take off everything except your sleeves
[00:48.06]All the pain is underneath
[00:51.87]I'm listenin'
[00:55.46]To everything
[00:58.22]Please, tell me everything
[01:01.31]I'll put my hand upon your chest
[01:05.45]So you forget your engravings
[01:26.74]Not one bite
[01:29.28]Stomach knots from our fight
[01:33.65]Can't do shit
[01:36.09]The puzzle pieces don't fit
[01:40.82]You warned me of other guys
[01:42.68]And then you told me you lied
[01:44.23]You schemed to see my reaction
[01:47.78]I had to throw up the truth
[01:49.65]But you already knew
[01:51.13]That in a month we'd be strangers
[01:54.37]Strip for me
[01:56.47]Take off everything except your sleeves
[02:00.55]All the pain is underneath
[02:04.36]I'm listenin'
[02:07.96]To everything
[02:10.75]Please, tell me everything
[02:14.06]I'll put my hand upon your chest
[02:17.92]So you forget your engravings
